A lot of the times my finace is with another girl. Sometimes I dream that he has died or is injured. Most of these dreams are very graphical and have a lot of impact on me and I get disturbed for the rest of the day. Please tell me what they mean. Question: Assalam Alaikum. My question is regarding strange dreams I am consistently seeing. A lot of the times my finace is with another girl. Sometimes I dream that he has died or is injured. Most of these dreams are very graphical and have a lot of impact on me and I get disturbed for the rest of the day. Please tell me what they mean. Answer ID: 11166 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 440/?=H/1430) Such dreams are generally inspired by the Satan; it is natural to be disturbed due to such dreams, but in-shaAllah this will not harm you. You should go to sleep in the state of wudhu, recite four Quls (Surah Al-Kafiroon, Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and Al-Naas) with durood seven times before and after, blow on hands and lie down on right side. Also, recite: لاحول ولا قوۃ الا باللہ العظیم thrice with durood thrice before and after, and blow on chest after every obligatory salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
